latin: Empedocles per spheram intelligibilem a Venere contentam, nihil aliud intelligit quam mundum archetipum ab ordine intra se manentis primae prouidentiae contentum.
translation: By the intelligible sphere contained by Venus, Empedocles understands nothing other than the archetypal world contained by the order of the first providence remaining within itself.
